503.description: At least one dependency is unreachable

delta.description: Units to add (negative: remove). Exactly one of `delta` and `on_hand`.

on_hand.description: Set the counted stock; the difference is recorded as the delta.

applied.description: False when this `Idempotency-Key` was already applied (or the change was zero).

actor.description: Better Auth user id, or `platform` for superadmin operations.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; absent on the last page.

parent_id.description: New parent, `null` for the root level.

position.description: 0-based index among the new siblings; larger values append.

items.description: Root categories with nested `children`, siblings in position order.

Cause.description: Why an interval has its price.

oneOf.description: Currency of a fixed amount and of `min_subtotal_minor`.
Percent of the goods, in basis points (1500 = 15 %).
A fixed amount off the goods (capped at the goods total).
Required for a fixed discount or a minimum subtotal.

published.description: Available to all customers (advertised). Counts for the Omnibus reference.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; absent on the last page.

Currency.description:
Currencies used by EU markets: the euro and the member states' own currencies.
`BGN` is historic (Bulgaria adopted the euro on 2026-01-01) and kept for old documents.

Gpsr.description: EU General Product Safety Regulation data (Regulation (EU) 2023/988, art. 19).

oneOf.description: Required when the manufacturer is established outside the EU.

GpsrParty.description: Name, postal address and an electronic contact (email or URL).

imported.description: The price arrived by import; nothing is known about the price before it.

track.description: Untracked stock is never checked (services, dropshipping).

memberships.description: Tenants the user can act in (send one as `X-Tenant-Id`).

parent_id.description: `null` for a root category. The new category is appended to its siblings.

code.description: Lowercase identifier, unique per tenant, e.g. `sk`.

is_default.description: Makes this the tenant's default market (the previous default loses the flag).

currency.description: Fixed after creation. Prices are gross (VAT included).

market_ids.description: Markets that sell from this list (their currency must match).

content_type.description: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp` or `image/gif`. Must be sent with the PUT.

filename.description: Original file name, for display only.

size.description: Exact size in bytes (at most 20 MB); `complete` checks the uploaded file against it.

claim.description: Whether the storefront may show a reduction (strikethrough + percent) at all.

current_minor.description: The price in force at the evaluation time.

discount_percent.description: Whole percent off the reference, rounded down (never overstated).

on_sale.description: A sale sets the current price (a reduction is being announced).

reduction_started_at.description: Start of the current reduction chain.

reference_minor.description: Lowest price in the 30 days before `reduction_started_at`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page (the last key); absent on the last page.

value.description: `{"cs": "bavlna"}` for text parameters, a number or a boolean otherwise.

variant_sku.description: Variant-level value (by SKU); omit for a product-level value.

PriceChangeReason.description: Why the base prices change (recorded on the price intervals).

market_ids.description: The complete set of markets using this list; markets removed from it lose their list.

imported.description:
The prices come from an import: for new prices the history before now is unknown, so
no reduction may be claimed for 30 days (A18).

type.description: Always `about:blank`; `code` carries the specific error kind.

ProductInput.description: A product document, as written by `POST /products` and `PUT /products/{id}`.

tax_categories.description: Country -> tax category code (`reduced`, ...); countries not listed use `standard` (A3).

unit_quantity.description: Content in `unit_measure` units (0.75 for 750 ml with `l`); set together with it.

variant_sku.description: Shows the image for one variant only (by SKU).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

ProductSummary.description: A row of the product list.

description_html.description: Sanitized on write: unsafe markup is removed.

status.description:
`ok` when the core dependencies (database, storage) are `ok`. Meilisearch is reported
but not required: search degrades, the shop keeps working (spec A30).

Resolved.description: What the edge needs to serve a hostname (spec §5.1, `GET /internal/v1/resolve`).

Role.description:
Staff roles, weakest first (spec §5.3). `staff` has no settings, payment config, staff
management or exports.

oneOf.description: Percent off in basis points (1500 = 15 %), rounded half up to the minor unit.
A fixed amount off each unit; applies only to price lists in `currency`.

starts_at.description: Default: now. A start in the past means now; a started sale keeps its start.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; absent on the last page.

category_ids.description: Products in these categories or any of their subcategories.

rate.description: Percent as a decimal string, e.g. `"12"` or `"13.5"`.

TaxMode.description: Whether prices are entered gross (B2C, default) or net.

cash_rounding_in_vat_base.description:
Whether the cash rounding line is taxed (A16). Default false: outside the VAT base.
Confirm with an accountant before enabling.

origin_threshold_confirmed_at.description: When the merchant confirmed eligibility for the origin-country threshold regime.

confirm_origin_threshold.description:
Required (true) when switching to `origin_threshold`: the merchant confirms their EU
distance sales stay under EUR 10 000 per year. The time of confirmation is stored.

UnitMeasure.description: Basis of the unit price shown next to the price (per kg, per l, ...).

UploadTarget.description: Where and how to upload the file.

headers.description: Headers the upload must send exactly as given (they are part of the signature).

ean.description: GTIN-8/12/13/14 with a valid check digit.

id.description: Existing variant to update; omit for a new variant.

is_default.description: At most one; defaults to the first variant.

option_values.description: One value code per product option: `{"color": "red", "size": "m"}`.

amount_minor.description: Gross base price in minor units.

compare_at_minor.description: Display-only "was"/recommended price, never a reduction basis (A18).

intervals.description: The full effective-price timeline, oldest first, including scheduled future changes.

oneOf.description: The current base price entry (absent when the variant is not priced in this list).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

staff_jwt.description: EdDSA JWT from the auth service (`GET /api/auth/token`), aud=admin-api
